metadata.heading: Clinic AI Test
facts: 20,000 SF outpatient clinic — one storey, NEC 517
1000 kW generator; LS 225 A / Critical 400 A / Equipment 1200 A ATSs

compositor_halts.text: COMPOSITOR_HALT: feeder distances not provided (T3-EOR). No voltage-drop calculation performed; no A-5 tags. Fault current below each bus is NOT attenuated for feeder impedance — the 56.5 kA service value is a conservative bound for every 480 V normal-side device, and the 208 V values are infinite-primary-bus bounds.
compositor_halts.blocks: Voltage-drop calculation · A-5 tags · per-device fault current

compositor_halts.topic: Utility fault current + transformer impedance — DERIVED, not confirmed
compositor_halts.text: COMPOSITOR_HALT: utility available fault current and the utility transformer nameplate were not provided. Derived on a worst-case basis: 2500 kVA (next standard size above the 2494 kVA a 3000 A / 480 V service needs), %Z 5.75 less the IEEE C57.12.00 -7.5% tolerance = 5.319%, infinite primary bus: 3007 A / 0.05319 = 56,535 A sym, so 65 kAIC. No motor contribution. The utility letter and transformer nameplate must confirm before AIC ratings are released for procurement.
compositor_halts.blocks: AIC ratings released for procurement · DV-4 bus bracing verified against utility data

compositor_halts.text: COMPOSITOR_HALT: no connected-load or panel schedule was provided (T3-EOR). Every panel rating not stated by the owner is a Tier-2 default and no NEC 220 / 517 demand calculation was performed. Note the stated 3000 A service is 125 VA/SF on 20,000 SF — roughly 4-8x a typical outpatient clinic. Live feeder trips total 2920 A on the 3000 A bus.
compositor_halts.blocks: Service-size verification · panel schedules · feeder sizing confirmation

compositor_halts.topic: Generator breaker, feeder and capacity — Tier-3 values FILLED by compositor
compositor_halts.text: COMPOSITOR_HALT: generator feeder sizing is EOR input with no schedule lookup (NEC 445.13). At the owner's direction the compositor FILLED: 1000 kW / 1250 kVA at 0.8 PF, FLA 1503.5 A; integral breaker 2000AF/1600AT LSI 100% rated (NEC 445.12); feeder sized to the 1600 A OCPD on feeder_schedule tag 16004, (6) 3 1/2"C - (4)500 AL + 350 AL GND. Aggregate ATS ratings 1825 A exceed the generator FLA — acceptable only with load diversity, equipment-branch delayed transfer and load shed (NEC 517.35 / 700.4(B)); the generator sizing study is owed.
compositor_halts.blocks: Generator feeder release · generator sizing study · EM board main rating

compositor_halts.text: COMPOSITOR_HALT: X"d 0.12 pu assumed (worst case, low end of the typical 0.12-0.18 range) for the emergency-source fault current: 1503.5 A / 0.12 = 12,529 A sym on the EM bus. Generator submittal data must confirm before the EM board 22 kAIC rating is released.
compositor_halts.blocks: EM board AIC release · ATS emergency-side withstand verification

compositor_notes.text: 480Y/277V, 3 phase 4 wire. Stated: 3000 A, 480 V 3-phase; wye/4W is the Tier-2 default.

Outpatient clinic, 20,000 SF, one storey (Level 1). NEC 517 health-care facility with an essential electrical system (Life Safety / Critical / Equipment branches) as stated. Single storey: no A-7 level lines, no riser cascades.

The life-safety "225-240 volt panel" is read as a 225 A, 480Y/277V panel (it feeds a 480 V-primary 45 kVA step-down). The critical "440-volt panel" is read as 480Y/277V. The plug branch "panel that feeds through to another one" is drawn as 2P-1-A (MCB) feed-through to 2P-1-B (MLO).

compositor_notes.topic: Branch architecture — 480 V panels ahead of the step-downs
compositor_notes.text: Each 400 A plug / mechanical branch is drawn as a 400 A 480Y/277V panel (4P-1-A / 4M-1-A) whose internal breaker feeds the step-down, because a 400 A breaker cannot protect a 112.5 kVA (135 A) or 75 kVA (90 A) primary within NEC 450.3(B). The kitchen 45 kVA unit is fed directly from the switchboard (CB-04, 70 A primary OCPD).

compositor_notes.topic: Worst-case impedance basis for fault current
compositor_notes.text: Every dry-type unit uses percent_z.low from transformer_impedance_V1_0_0.json on an infinite primary bus: 112.5 kVA 312.3 A / 0.031 = 10,073 A; 75 kVA 208.2 A / 0.044 = 4,731 A; 45 kVA 124.9 A / 0.034 = 3,674 A. Correct bound for AIC; wrong one for voltage drop.

Every dry-type secondary OCPD is the main of the panel it feeds (400 A for 112.5 kVA, 250 A for 75 kVA, 150 A for 45 kVA — schedule lookups), protecting the secondary conductors. Hence MCB on those panels. 2P-1-B, fed through from 2P-1-A, is MLO.

Health-care facility with a GFP service main: every normal-side feeder breaker on 4MSB-1-A is LSIG (second level of GFP). Not applied on the essential electrical system — GFP is not required on the EES and the generator / EM main use ground-fault indication only.

compositor_notes.topic: Emergency architecture and EM board main
compositor_notes.text: Golden-case pattern: generator-fed EM switchboard E4MSB-1-A (2000 A, 22 kAIC, two-level with a 2000AF/1600AT LSI main — TIER 2 OVERRIDE of the MLO default, matching the golden two-level board). Its breakers feed the ATS emergency (source 2) inputs; normal (source 1) inputs come from 4MSB-1-A on cross-sheet feeders.

LS4A-1-A 225 A, C4A-1-A 400 A, EQ4A-1-A 1200 A, 3-pole with solid neutral (generator is not a separately derived system — no EM-side N-G bond), 65 kA withstand. nec_class prose LIFE SAFETY / CRITICAL / EQUIPMENT drives the engine 700 -> 701 -> 702 drawing order; only the Life Safety section is classed 700 — the Critical and Equipment branches are NEC 517 branches, not Article 701/702 systems. Equipment branch transfer is delayed-automatic.
Two 400 A / 3P spares and two spaces on 4MSB-1-A; one 225 A / 3P spare and one space on E4MSB-1-A.
